rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded/full blastocyst with thinned zona and a loosely grouped ICM consistent with B grade; TE description as cohesive but not perfect is reasonable. Minor overcalling of TE toward low-A and some uncertainty from single-image interpretation prevent a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior miscarriage, male-factor context, BMI, smoking/alcohol, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to morphology and patient factors. Minor speculative elements (fresh-vs-frozen implications, trigger timing from MII yield) slightly weaken the chain.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: SET at age 26, caution that morphology does not equal ploidy, lifestyle optimization, and selective rather than routine PGT-A. Slight overemphasis on endometrial thickness concerns and some nonessential speculative suggestions keep it from full marks.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, cavity/timing review, luteal support considerations, smoking/alcohol cessation, and future evaluation pathways if failure or repeat miscarriage occurs.
